meta.origin: Ported from the AIA Design System artifact (design source, not a dependency). This file is the one source; scripts/build-tokens.mjs generates src/app/tokens.css and src/design/tokens.ts from it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground in Studio. Light: paper with a faint warm cast so eight-hour sessions do not glare. Dark: graphite. Every text token is verified against it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, table bodies, cards, the stage rail track. One step above `surface`; separated by `border`, never by shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: table headers, inputs, code and fingerprint blocks, the budget meter track.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers only (the park-and-ask dialog, command palette). Pairs with `shadow-overlay`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows, panels and cells. Decorative; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes) and the scope bar edge. >= 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and every figure a conclusion rests on. >= 7:1 (AA-plus) on all surfaces and status washes in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, metadata, table headers. >= 4.5:1 on surface, raised, sunken and overlay.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, hints, NOT_STARTED stages. >= 4.5:1 on all four surfaces — faint, never illegible.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse fields: the RECOVERY_REQUIRED block, tooltips, the keyboard-shortcut overlay.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one precise accent: selection, links, the live edge of a RUNNING process, the primary action. Used sparingly — never decoration, never for a warning.

tokens.name: signal-wash
tokens.usage: Selected row / selected stage background. `ink` stays >= 7:1 on it.

tokens.name: signal-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary (solid `signal`) action. One step further from `surface` than `signal`; `on-signal` stays >= 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: signal-wash-strong
tokens.usage: Hover of a `signal-wash` surface (a soft action, a selectable row). `ink` >= 7:1 and `signal` >= 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: The faintest signal ground: an informational panel or a highlighted cell that is not a selection. Lighter than `signal-wash` so it is never mistaken for one; `ink` >= 7:1, `ink-muted` and `signal` >= 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: signal-edge
tokens.usage: Decorative edge of a `signal-wash` or `signal-tint` element (soft chips, informational panels). Never the only boundary of a control — controls use `border-strong`.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `signal` fill (primary button).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline, always drawn with a 2px `surface` gap so it sits on a known ground; >= 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: AI action fill (Studio v3): only a control that starts an AI worker job, which is paid from the study budget. Never used for anything else.

tokens.name: ai-strong
tokens.usage: The primary AI action's border, and its fill on hover.

tokens.name: ai-wash
tokens.usage: The secondary AI action's ground; the "AI úloha" badge of the job panel. Studio v3's translucent ai (9 % / 14 %, edge 45 % / 50 %), made opaque on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ai-edge
tokens.usage: The secondary AI action's border. Studio v3's translucent ai (9 % / 14 %, edge 45 % / 50 %), made opaque on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ai-ink
tokens.usage: AI label text on surfaces and on ai-wash.

tokens.name: on-ai
tokens.usage: Text on an ai fill.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: RUNNING / EXECUTING: the machine is working, nothing is needed from you. Same hue as `signal` on purpose: the live edge.

tokens.name: status-running-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a running row or stage cell.

tokens.name: status-you
tokens.usage: RESERVED for "parked, waiting on a person" (WAITING_USER, AWAITING_GATE, AWAITING_BUDGET, WAITING_CREDITS). Solid fill, the loudest thing on any screen. Never used for anything else — not warnings, not highlights, not a data series.

tokens.name: on-status-you
tokens.usage: Label and glyph on a solid `status-you` fill. >= 7:1.

tokens.name: status-you-ink
tokens.usage: Waiting-on-you text and glyphs on ordinary surfaces (the count in the nav, an inline "čeká na vás").

tokens.name: status-you-wash
tokens.usage: Row background for a parked-on-you item in Portfolio and run logs.

tokens.name: status-world
tokens.usage: "Parked, waiting on the world": WAITING_PROVIDER, WAITING_CAPACITY. Slate — calm, not alarming, visibly not running.

tokens.name: status-world-wash
tokens.usage: Row background for a waiting-on-the-world item.

tokens.name: status-fault
tokens.usage: FAILED and SCHEMA/PERMISSION failure text and glyphs; the uncertain part of the budget meter. Always with the × glyph and a label.

tokens.name: on-status-fault
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `status-fault` fill.

tokens.name: status-fault-wash
tokens.usage: Row background for a failed item.

tokens.name: status-recovery
tokens.usage: RECOVERY_REQUIRED block fill: inverse ink. The rarest, most serious state — a decision about money that may already be spent.

tokens.name: on-status-recovery
tokens.usage: Text on the recovery block.

tokens.name: status-recovery-hatch
tokens.usage: The 45-degree hatch band along the recovery block edge. >= 3:1 against `status-recovery`.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: DONE / COMPLETED / SUCCEEDED glyph: plain ink. Done is quiet, not celebratory — there is no green in the status family.

tokens.name: status-inert
tokens.usage: NOT_STARTED, BLOCKED, CANCELLED, SKIPPED, INVALIDATED glyphs and labels.

tokens.name: viz-cat-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series slot 1 (blue). Fixed order, never cycled. Plot area only.

tokens.name: viz-cat-2
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 2 (orange). Light theme 2.97:1 on surface: charts always carry direct labels or a table view (relief rule).

tokens.name: viz-cat-3
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 3 (aqua). Light 2.61:1: relief rule applies.

tokens.name: viz-cat-4
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 4 (violet).

tokens.name: viz-cat-5
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 5 (green).

tokens.name: viz-cat-6
tokens.usage: Categorical slot 6 (magenta). Light 2.50:1: relief rule. A seventh series folds into "Ostatní" or small multiples.

tokens.name: viz-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 1 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

tokens.name: viz-seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 2 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

tokens.name: viz-seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 3 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

tokens.name: viz-seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 4 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

tokens.name: viz-seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 5 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

tokens.name: viz-seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 6 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

tokens.name: viz-seq-7
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 7 of 7 (one hue, blue). Light: 1 = near zero, 7 = most. Dark flips the anchor: step 1 recedes into the dark surface.

tokens.name: viz-div-1
tokens.usage: Diverging negative arm (blue), step 1 of 7.

tokens.name: viz-div-2
tokens.usage: Diverging negative arm (blue), step 2 of 7.

tokens.name: viz-div-3
tokens.usage: Diverging negative arm (blue), step 3 of 7.

tokens.name: viz-div-4
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint — neutral grey, never a hue, step 4 of 7.

tokens.name: viz-div-5
tokens.usage: Diverging positive arm (orange), step 5 of 7.

tokens.name: viz-div-6
tokens.usage: Diverging positive arm (orange), step 6 of 7.

tokens.name: viz-div-7
tokens.usage: Diverging positive arm (orange), step 7 of 7.

tokens.name: viz-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines. Recessive.

tokens.name: viz-axis
tokens.usage: Axis labels and tick text. >= 4.5:1.

tokens.name: client-1
tokens.usage: Client accent (rose). Scope chrome only: the scope-bar band and the client monogram. Never on data, never on status.

tokens.name: client-2
tokens.usage: Client accent (umber). Scope chrome only.

tokens.name: client-3
tokens.usage: Client accent (moss). Scope chrome only.

tokens.name: client-4
tokens.usage: Client accent (teal). Scope chrome only.

tokens.name: client-5
tokens.usage: Client accent (iris). Scope chrome only.

tokens.name: client-6
tokens.usage: Client accent (plum). Scope chrome only.

tokens.name: on-client
tokens.usage: Monogram letters on a client accent tile. >= 4.5:1 on all six in both themes.

tokens.name: shell
tokens.usage: The app sidebar (Studio v3): graphite in both themes.

tokens.name: shell-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the sidebar.

tokens.name: shell-strong
tokens.usage: Active and emphasised text on the sidebar.

tokens.name: shell-item
tokens.usage: An inactive navigation item on the sidebar.

tokens.name: shell-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the sidebar.

tokens.name: shell-faint
tokens.usage: Section labels on the sidebar. Studio v3 gives #6c7079; lifted to 4.5:1 on shell.

tokens.name: shell-avatar
tokens.usage: The account avatar on the sidebar.

tokens.name: shell-avatar-ink
tokens.usage: Initials on the account avatar.

tokens.name: hue-blue
tokens.usage: Wayfinding tint: Klienti, Přehled, the research-design phase. Never a status.

tokens.name: hue-teal
tokens.usage: Wayfinding tint: Výzkumy. Never a status.

tokens.name: hue-orange
tokens.usage: Wayfinding tint: Simulace. Never a status.

tokens.name: hue-violet
tokens.usage: Wayfinding tint: Znalosti, Projektová paměť, the sample phase. Never a status.

tokens.name: hue-green
tokens.usage: Wayfinding tint: Data, Společenská inteligence, the run phase. Never a status.

tokens.name: hue-slate
tokens.usage: Wayfinding tint: Nastavení. Never a status.

tokens.name: shell-hue-blue
tokens.usage: hue-blue as an inactive navigation icon on the sidebar.

tokens.name: shell-hue-green
tokens.usage: hue-green as an inactive navigation icon on the sidebar.

tokens.name: shell-hue-violet
tokens.usage: hue-violet as an inactive navigation icon on the sidebar.

tokens.name: shell-hue-slate
tokens.usage: hue-slate as an inactive navigation icon on the sidebar.

tokens.name: doc-paper
tokens.usage: Deliverable register page. Identical in both themes: the report is paper even when the Studio is dark.

tokens.name: doc-ink
tokens.usage: Report prose and figures. 17:1 on `doc-paper`.

tokens.name: doc-muted
tokens.usage: Report captions, running heads, footnotes.

tokens.name: doc-rule
tokens.usage: Report table rules and figure frames.

tokens.name: doc-accent
tokens.usage: Report section numbers and the cover rule. The only colour a printed report needs; prints as dark grey.

tokens.name: doc-wash
tokens.usage: Report callout ground: the decision answer, the method status, notes. Paper, a step darker; prints as a light tint and survives greyscale.

tokens.name: evidence-mark
tokens.usage: Evidence-grade marks (the grade glyph, dashed/dotted underlines, hollow nodes). Achromatic by design so the grade survives greyscale print and never collides with status or data colour.

tokens.name: evidence-hatch
tokens.usage: Hatch strokes for modelled bars and cells.

tokens.name: null-mark
tokens.usage: The "not available" glyph and label. Full ink: missing data is information, never softer than a bad value.

tokens.name: suppressed-fill
tokens.usage: The solid redaction bar of a suppressed value.

tokens.name: budget-spent
tokens.usage: Settled spend segment of the budget meter.

tokens.name: budget-reserved
tokens.usage: Reserved-but-unsettled segment, drawn hatched.

tokens.name: budget-uncertain
tokens.usage: SETTLED_UNCERTAIN segment: money that may already be gone. Hatched and labelled, never rounded into spent.

tokens.name: scope-above
tokens.usage: The band of a cross-client surface (Portfolio, Admin): hatched ink instead of a client accent — you are above the boundary.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Alias of `signal-wash` for selected rows, nodes and text ranges.

styles.name: studio-title
styles.usage: Page title: study or screen name. One per screen.

styles.name: studio-heading
styles.usage: Panel and section headings.

styles.name: studio-body
styles.sample: Změna cílové skupiny znovu otevře 8 fází; Deep Research zůstává platný.
styles.usage: Default UI text in comfortable density.

styles.name: studio-body-compact
styles.usage: Dense tables: respondent explorer, usage ledger, run log.

styles.name: studio-label
styles.usage: Status chip labels, field labels, table headers. Sentence case, never all caps (Czech diacritics collide with caps height).

styles.name: studio-caption
styles.usage: Metadata and timestamps. 12px is the floor: nothing in AIA is set smaller.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Every compared number. Plex Sans figures are tabular by default (all digits 600 units): columns align without a feature flag.

styles.name: num-compact
styles.usage: Numbers inside compact tables.

styles.name: num-hero
styles.usage: The one figure of a headline answer or a budget meter total.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Identifiers: fingerprints, revision ids, run and step ids, ledger row ids. Slashed zero on (font-feature-settings "zero").

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Identifiers inside compact tables and the run log.

styles.name: doc-title
styles.usage: Report cover title. Source Serif 4, semibold, 33pt / 36pt.

styles.name: doc-h1
styles.usage: Report chapter heading, numbered.

styles.name: doc-h2
styles.usage: Report section heading.

styles.name: doc-lede
styles.sample: Čtyři z deseti dospělých by přešli k bance, která nabídne…
styles.usage: The headline answer paragraph on the report page.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: Rozdíl mezi Prahou a zbytkem republiky je statisticky významný.
styles.usage: Report prose. Prints at 11.25pt / 18pt with 12pt paragraph spacing.

styles.name: doc-caption
styles.sample: Obr. 3  Ochota přejít podle věku (n = 1 204; kalibrované jádro)
styles.usage: Figure and table captions: always name n and the evidence grade.

styles.name: doc-footnote
styles.sample: ¹ Hodnota modelována z behaviorálního prioru; nejde o měření.
styles.usage: Footnotes and the evidence appendix.

styles.name: doc-subtitle
styles.sample: Závěrečná zpráva ze syntetického panelového výzkumu
styles.usage: Cover subtitle, under the title.

styles.name: doc-kicker
styles.usage: Eyebrow above a title: the report kind on the cover, the chapter number above a chapter title.

styles.name: doc-h3
styles.usage: Report subsection heading.

styles.name: doc-meta
styles.usage: Cover metadata, the document control page, key–value lines.

styles.name: doc-running
styles.sample: Důvěra v digitální bankovnictví 2026 · 2  Hlavní zjištění
styles.usage: Running heads and footers.

styles.name: doc-table
styles.usage: Table body. Numbers are tabular figures in Plex Sans.

styles.name: doc-table-head
styles.usage: Table header row and the stub column head. Units live here, not in cells.

styles.name: doc-kpi
styles.usage: The value in a KPI tile. Always paired with its label, n and evidence grade.

styles.name: doc-quote
styles.usage: A verbatim quote. Always attributed, and labelled synthetic when it is.

styles.name: doc-mono
styles.usage: Fingerprints, run identifiers and other machine text in the audit appendix.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap inside chips; gaps between stacked meter segments.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon padding; compact cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Cell horizontal padding; gap between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding; compact panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing in Studio.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Deliverable margins and chapter spacing.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, the stage rail, the scope bar, report figures. Precision reads square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, buttons, cells with a state fill.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, popovers. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Studio v3: buttons in the shell and the steps, inputs, navigation items.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Studio v3: step section cards, radio cards, the action dock.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Studio v3: questionnaire block panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Studio v3: selection chips, count badges, the step eyebrow.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers only. Everything else is flat and bordered.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Borders, rules, gridlines.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Icon and status-glyph strokes at 16px.

tokens.name: stroke-emphasis
tokens.usage: Chart lines, the focus ring, the selected-stage underline.

tokens.name: stroke-scope
tokens.usage: The client accent band of the scope bar.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Row height in compact density: respondent explorer, usage ledger, run log.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Row height in comfortable density: Portfolio, Admin lists.

tokens.name: control-compact
tokens.usage: Button and input height in compact density.

tokens.name: control-comfortable
tokens.usage: Button and input height in comfortable density. Hit area never below 24px (WCAG 2.2 target size).

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Everything under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-confirm
tokens.usage: State-change confirmation: a chip changing status, a row selected. Motion confirms a transition that happened; it never anticipates one.

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs opening.

tokens.name: z-scope
tokens.usage: The scope bar: above all page content, it must never scroll away or be covered.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Transient confirmations. Never used for a parked or failed state — those live in the page.

print.usage: Print geometry and faces for the DOCX report (packages/aia_core/src/aia_core/domain/report/print_tokens.py is generated from this). Colours come from the light theme: a report is paper even when the Studio is dark.
